items.name: nb_00_demo_walkthrough
items.description: Sequential stakeholder demo walkthrough — 9 Acts covering: business problem, data foundation, metadata extraction, lh_metadata hub, certified KPI governance, TMDL write-back, Copilot grounding, Purview integration, and governance outcomes. Run after nb_01 through nb_05.

items.name: nb_01_setup_demo_environment
items.description: Step 1: Creates Delta tables in lh_enercare_demo from Ontario energy company sample data (50 customers, 56 service accounts, 38 equipment, 68 contracts). Run before nb_02.

items.name: nb_01_setup_demo_environment
items.description: Step 1: Creates Delta tables in lh_enercare_demo from Ontario energy company sample data (50 customers, 56 service accounts, 38 equipment, 68 contracts). Run before nb_02.

items.name: nb_02_metadata_pipeline_demo
items.description: Full 5-phase metadata governance pipeline: extract SQL module headers, write meta.* Delta tables to lh_metadata, apply Delta column comments, preview Purview Atlas push. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run; flip to False with SQL Server JDBC creds for production.

items.name: nb_02_metadata_pipeline_demo
items.description: Full 5-phase metadata governance pipeline: extract SQL module headers, write meta.* Delta tables to lh_metadata, apply Delta column comments, preview Purview Atlas push. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run; flip to False with SQL Server JDBC creds for production.

items.name: nb_03_pbi_star_schema
items.description: West3 copy of the star-schema build notebook targeting lh_enercare_demo in Enercare-West3.

items.name: nb_04_generate_tmdl
items.description: G3: Reads descriptions from lh_metadata, fetches live TMDL via Fabric REST API, injects descriptions/KPI defs/AI instructions, pushes back to semantic model. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run.

items.name: nb_04_sempy_writeback
items.description: G3: Reads curated metadata from lh_metadata, uses SemPy for model inventory, and applies write-back through SemPy Labs. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run.

items.name: nb_04a_extend_metadata_schema
items.description: G1+G2: Extends lh_metadata schema (ALTER TABLE kpi_metadata + 3 new tables) and seeds 17 KPIs + Copilot verified answers. Run after nb_02.

items.name: nb_04a_extend_metadata_schema
items.description: G1+G2: Extends lh_metadata schema (ALTER TABLE kpi_metadata + 3 new tables) and seeds 17 KPIs + Copilot verified answers. Run after nb_02.

items.name: nb_05_push_qa_verified_answers
items.description: Reads ai_instruction + verified_answer rows from lh_metadata.ai_metadata, builds enhanced PBI_AI_Instructions annotation (instructions + verified Q&A pairs), pushes to BrookfieldEnercare semantic model via Fabric REST API. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run.

items.name: nb_05_push_qa_verified_answers
items.description: Reads ai_instruction + verified_answer rows from lh_metadata.ai_metadata and publishes them as two distinct semantic-model annotations — PBI_AI_Instructions (ai_instruction rows) and PBI_AI_VerifiedAnswers (verified_answer rows) — via SemPy Labs. DEMO_MODE=True for dry-run.

items.name: nb_05a_publish_synthetic_data_to_sql
items.description: Publishes the synthetic Enercare transactional source data from lh_enercare_demo into Azure SQL in sub2 so Fabric mirroring can use SQL as the authoritative demo source.

items.name: nb_05a_publish_synthetic_data_to_sql
items.description: Publishes the synthetic Enercare transactional source data from lh_enercare_demo into Azure SQL in sub2 so Fabric mirroring can use SQL as the authoritative demo source.

items.name: nb_05b_test_sql_connectivity
items.description: Minimal Fabric notebook smoke test that validates JDBC connectivity from the Enercare workspace to sqlserver-sk2 through the approved managed private endpoint.

items.name: nb_07_publish_to_purview
items.description: Publishes Day 2 governance domains and data products to Purview Atlas with dry-run by default

items.name: nb_07a_ingest_customer_files
items.description: Ingests SQL-mirrored governance metadata tables and writes schema-validated Delta tables to lh_metadata.metadata.*

items.name: nb_07b_merge_customer_metadata
items.description: Merges glossary/CDE/label/data-product metadata with BrookfieldEnercare semantic inventory and writes lh_metadata.metadata.sm_annotations

items.name: nb_08_purview_glossary_cde
items.description: Publishes glossary terms and critical data elements to Purview Atlas with validation and dry-run payloads

items.name: nb_09_purview_labels_lineage
items.description: Builds Purview sensitivity classification payloads and validates SQL-to-Fabric lineage stage gates

items.name: nb_10_purview_stewardship_ai
items.description: Validates stewardship, certification, DLP readiness, and governed AI consumption readiness

items.name: nb_11_gated_governance_sync
items.description: Phase 4 (P4-4): automated apply-on-approve step for gated governance change requests.

items.name: nb_12_purview_workflow_sync
items.description: P1: observe one native Purview GT-SLA publication workflow and persist idempotent SQL ledger evidence.

items.name: nb_13_semantic_reconcile
items.description: P2: reconcile approved GT-SLA metadata to the semantic model, verify read-back, and close the governance request.

items.name: nb_14_purview_access_sync
items.description: P3: bridge one native Purview Data Product access decision (DP-CUST360) into idempotent SQL ledger evidence. Audit-only; attested decision, no semantic mutation.

items.name: nb_15_purview_dataproduct_sync
items.description: P4: observe one native Purview Data Product publish workflow (DP-SVCPERF) and persist idempotent SQL ledger evidence.

items.name: nb_16_dataproduct_semantic_reconcile
items.description: P4 semantic reconciliation for an approved Purview Data Product publish (DP-SVCPERF).
